Nö ZMG 1883, 538 ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular חָשׁ Deut 32:35 (or Participle , but see Di), 1 singular חַשְׁתִּי Psa 119:60 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתַּ֫חַשׁ (sic!) Job 31:5 Ges § 72 R. 9; Imperative חוּ֫שָׁה 1Sam 20:38 6 t. Psalms, + Psa 71:12 Qr (Kt חישׁה ); Infinitive suffix חוּשִׁי Job 20:2 ; Participle active חָשׁ Hab 1:8 + Isa 8:1 , 3 in proper name; passive חֻשִׁיּם Num 32:17 ; but see below: — make haste Deut 32:35 (|| קרוב ), Psa 119:60 ; in prophetic proper name בַּז֑ חָשׁ שָׁלָל מַהֵר Isa 8:1 , 3 ; of eagle (in simile of Chald. army) לאכול חשׁ נשׁר Hab 1:8 ; Job 31:5 subject רנל , followed by עלמֿרמה ; בּי חוּ֫שִׁי 20:2 my haste in me , i.e. my inward excitement — especially Imperative 1Sam 20:38 (|| מהרה ), and in Psalms: followed by לְעַזְרָתִי 22:20 ; 1Sam 38:23; 1Sam 40:14; 1Sam 70:2; 1Sam 71:12 (Qr); followed by לִי 1Sam 70:6; 1Sam 141:1; passive participle חֻשִׁים נֵחָלֵץ Num 32:17 , but probably for חֲמֻשִׁים (Kn Di compare Exod 13:18 etc.); Ba NB 180 retains חוּשִׁים and regards it as active (intransitive) = hastening . Hiph`il Perfect הֵחִישׁוּ Judg 20:27 ; Imperfect יָחִישׁ Isa 28:16 ; יָחִ֫ישָׁה coh. 5:19 (Ges § 48 . 3); אָחִ֫ישָׁה coh. Psa 55:9 ; suffix אֲחִישֶׁנָּה Isa 60:22 ; — 1 shew haste, act quickly Judg 20:37 ; hasten, come quickly Isa 5:19 (subject מַעֲשֵׂהוּ , || יְמַהֵר ; others: let him hasten on his work ), יָחִישׁ 28:16 hasten away (flee), or hasten about distractedly (si vera lectio; Che Guthe read ימישׁ yield, give way ). 2 transitive with suffix Isa 60:22 I will hasten it ; with accusative Psa 55:9 I would hasten (= secure quickly) my escape. II. [ חוּשׁ ] verb feel, enjoy (with the senses) (Now compares Arabic feel, perceive by senses; Late Hebrew חוּשׁ feel pain ; Aramaic , חוּשׁ , feel pain ; Ethiopic : perception ) — only Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יָחוּשׁ וּמִי יאֹכַל מִּי Eccl 2:25 who can eat and who can feel (i.e. enjoy pleasure )?
